security_audit.summary: Most static findings are benign documentation, design terminology, mocked tests, or expected credential configuration. Confirmed findings expose API keys through unrestricted polling destinations and cross-origin redirects. Semantic findings identify incomplete DNS checks, unsanitized SVG and HTML output, and disabled browser sandboxing; no evidence found of deliberate prompt injection.

remediation.issue: Polling URLs and redirects can disclose provider credentials to unrelated hosts.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist provider origins before attaching credentials, reject cross-origin API redirects, and add tests for hostile result URLs and redirects.

remediation.issue: Hostname validation does not check resolved destination addresses.
remediation.suggestion: Validate all resolved IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, reject private destinations, and prevent DNS rebinding across connections and redirects.

remediation.issue: Generated SVG can retain active content.
remediation.suggestion: Parse and sanitize SVG with an element and attribute allowlist; reject scripts, event handlers, foreignObject, and external URLs before saving.

remediation.issue: Presentation inputs are inserted into HTML without escaping.
remediation.suggestion: Escape all dynamic text and attribute values, validate style values separately, and test brand names and filenames containing markup.

remediation.issue: The screenshot example disables Chrome sandboxing.
remediation.suggestion: Remove --no-sandbox from the default command; document isolated, unprivileged execution for environments that cannot enable the sandbox.

semantic_findings.title: DNS Resolution Bypasses Private Address Checks
semantic_findings.description: URL validation rejects literal private IP addresses but accepts unresolved hostnames. A provider-controlled hostname resolving internally can bypass the intended network boundary.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Nonliteral hostnames return before any DNS address check. Exploitation requires a suitable HTTPS endpoint and a malicious or compromised provider response.

semantic_findings.title: Generated SVG Is Saved Without Active Content Filtering
semantic_findings.description: SVG extraction checks text structure but preserves scripts, event handlers, and external references. Malicious generated markup can execute when opened directly or embedded inline.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The extraction and save path contains no SVG element or attribute allowlist. Prompt instructions against external references do not enforce output safety.

semantic_findings.title: Presentation Labels Are Interpolated Without HTML Escaping
semantic_findings.description: Brand names and filename-derived labels enter HTML text and attributes without escaping. Crafted input can inject markup or scripts when the presentation is opened.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Python f-strings insert input directly into the title, image attributes, and headings. Exploitation requires crafted labels and opening the generated document.

semantic_findings.title: Screenshot Workflow Disables Browser Sandboxing
semantic_findings.description: The recommended Chrome command includes --no-sandbox while rendering HTML that may load external resources. This removes browser containment during screenshot export.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented command explicitly disables the Chrome sandbox without an isolation requirement. This increases compromise impact if rendered content exploits a browser vulnerability.

content.user_title: Create Logos, Icons, Mockups, and Presentations
content.value_statement: Creating consistent visual assets across formats requires repeated research and setup. This skill combines searchable design references, asset generators, and HTML workflows.
actual_capabilities: Search local logo styles, palettes, and industry references to assemble design briefs.
Generate raster logo concepts with Gemini, Atlas Cloud, or MuAPI, including batch variations.
Generate Gemini corporate identity mockups using optional supplied logo images.
Render a local HTML presentation from PNG mockups with deliverable descriptions.
Generate SVG icons with style, color, batch, and multiple-size options.
Guide HTML slides, banners, and social images using templates, platform dimensions, and optional browser capture.
limitations: AI generation needs provider credentials, internet access, and applicable paid API usage; model availability can change.
Brand, token, UI styling, and some slide workflows depend on sibling skills not included in this audited directory.
PNG screenshot export requires an available browser tool; social posting, video generation, and print production are outside scope.
Generated artwork needs visual and security review; the corporate identity presentation renderer currently accepts PNG images only.

use_cases.title: Explore a Startup Identity
use_cases.description: Compare logo directions and create business card or signage mockups before committing to a brand identity.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Multi-Platform Campaign
use_cases.description: Develop coordinated banner and social image concepts at platform-specific dimensions, then export approved layouts when browser capture is available.

use_cases.title: Prototype Interface Icons
use_cases.description: Generate SVG icon variations with consistent styling, colors, and display sizes for review before application integration.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Logo Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Search local logo references for [brand] in [industry]. Recommend three styles and a palette with reasons. Do not call external APIs.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Logo Concepts
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three white-background logo concepts for [brand] using [provider] and [style]. Confirm API usage and costs first. Save approved outputs in [directory].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: generate concepts after provider approval.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Identity Presentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [logo image] to create business card, letterhead, and signage mockups for [brand]. Confirm external uploads first. Build an HTML presentation from PNG outputs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine mockups and a local presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Campaign Asset Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan coordinated LinkedIn, Instagram post, and story assets for [campaign]. Apply [brand guidelines] and [approved assets]. Check sibling skills and browser availability before proceeding. Present concepts before rendering. Review generated HTML and SVG before previewing. Report export dimensions and pending work.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate multiple formats and review stages.

output_examples.input: Recommend a logo direction for a technology consultancy without using an API.
output: Direction: a minimalist geometric mark with a restrained blue and teal palette.
Typography: a clear sans-serif with strong readability at small sizes.
Next review: compare the mark in monochrome and on a business card.

output_examples.input: Prepare a business card mockup presentation using an approved logo.
output: Mockup concept: a white business card with the supplied logo and restrained brand accents.
Presentation structure: brand overview, mockup image, intended use, and material guidance.
Review notes: verify logo accuracy, contact text, image format, and presentation rendering.

output_examples.input: Plan a coordinated Instagram post and story for a product announcement.
output: Post layout: 1080 by 1080 pixels with the product image, announcement headline, and one call to action.
Story layout: 1080 by 1920 pixels with important text inside the central safe area.
Export status: deliver HTML first when browser capture is unavailable; PNG export remains pending.

best_practices: Provide approved brand guidelines, target platforms, exact dimensions, and a dedicated output directory before generation.
Approve provider requests and logo uploads explicitly; use dedicated API credentials and avoid confidential material.
Review generated HTML and SVG before opening; verify image dimensions, text accuracy, contrast, and safe zones before delivery.
anti_patterns: Treating generated logos or mockups as final trademark clearance or print-ready production artwork.
Assuming sibling skills, provider credentials, or screenshot tools are installed without checking.
Opening unreviewed generated markup or sending confidential brand assets to external providers without approval.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The package declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Specific tools and sibling skill integrations depend on the host environment.

faq.question: Can I use it without an API key?
faq.answer: Local reference searches, design briefs, and HTML planning can work without provider credentials. AI logo, mockup, and icon generation requires configured credentials.

faq.question: Which providers generate logos?
faq.answer: The logo script supports Gemini by default, with optional Atlas Cloud and MuAPI providers. Provider selection and credentials must be configured.

faq.question: Can it use my existing logo?
faq.answer: The corporate identity generator accepts a local logo image for Gemini image editing. Approve uploading that image before generation.

faq.question: Does it post directly to social platforms?
faq.answer: No. It guides asset design and screenshot export, not social posting or scheduling. Browser capture must be available for PNG exports.

faq.question: What security precautions are needed?
faq.answer: Restrict authenticated requests to approved provider origins. Sanitize generated markup, keep browser sandboxing enabled, and review external requests before using sensitive assets.
